The Ultimate Mowing Machines™

Powerful. Efficient. Built for serious debris control.

The Ferris FB2000 Stand-On Blower is designed for professional landscapers who need high-performance debris management and exceptional maneuverability. With a compact footprint and intuitive controls, this blower delivers unmatched productivity, allowing you to clear large areas quickly and efficiently.

The new Ferris FB2000, V23 is powered by a 23 HP Vanguard® V-Twin engine and features a patented dual-direction air flow chute delivering 6,500 CFM at speeds up to 91 MPH. Perfect for clearing leaves, grass clippings, and other debris from parking lots, sports fields, commercial properties, and more.

Features may include:

High-Performance Power
23 HP Vanguard® V-Twin engine provides dependable starting and smooth operation even in demanding conditions.

Dual Air Flow Control
Patented foot-operated air flow adjustment allows for instant directional changes—left or right—without stopping.

Massive Air Output
Delivers up to 6,500 CFM at a max air speed of 91 MPH for efficient clearing of heavy debris.

Compact and Agile
Compact 45.5″ width enables easy access through gates and around tight areas.

Commercial Durability
Heavy-duty construction, welded steel frame, and proven components for season-after-season performance.

Stand-On Design
Operator-focused platform provides excellent visibility, comfort, and control with a smaller footprint than ride-on equipment.

Simple Controls
Intuitive hand and foot controls allow for quick learning and responsive operation.

Ideal for Landscapers and Property Managers
Perfect for large-scale debris cleanup in a wide variety of environments.
